description: MaCySTe is a University of Genova testbed for research on shipboard cybersecurity. It combines a simulated ship with networked navigation, radar, propulsion and steering components so that researchers can study cyber-physical behaviour and train maritime operators. The documented tools generate NMEA navigation messages, radar-image streams and industrial-control data from simulated controllers. Spatial coverage and duration depend on the selected virtual ship and environment. The public source repository and reference manual are freely accessible under AGPL-3.0. Deployment uses Linux, containers and Python; the core scenario requires at least four CPU cores, 10 GB RAM and 50 GB storage. It can support testing of monitoring methods and investigation of how communication or control failures affect simulated operations. A limitation is the substantial setup requirement and dependence on the fidelity of the virtual equipment and ship simulator. Simulated exercises do not establish vessel certification or operational reliability. No directly related existing catalogue record was established. This review inspected documentation only and did not deploy the testbed.
name: MaCySTe maritime cybersecurity testbed
